name: Media Player
author: loneycoffee
description: What is playing on the bar, behind the logo of the app playing it (Spotify, YouTube, YouTube Music, SoundCloud, Twitch, ...), with previous, play/pause and next. Click to jump to the app's window and workspace; right click opens a panel with the cover, progress and every player. Works with any MPRIS player. Toggle the panel with: omarchy-shell shell toggle media-player
